title: The child-repo runner batches each repo in parallel, so one repo's hand-offs never wait on another repo's batch
why: banchi lanes #1076 and #1077 sat about 1 h 16 min with no lane running while runner 9 built q_max batch 1107t (coordinator, 21:17 CST Nov 7). Idle PRs are the owner's stated top problem.
note: Fix, one of: the child-repo runner opens a repo's batch as soon as its hand-offs pass lane lint, while another repo's batch CI runs; or each repo gets its own runner. Context: banchi #1078 merged as bdafdc9be at 21:16 CST (runner 9). Filed from the coordinator, 21:17 CST Nov 7; no earlier step held it. Filed 21:17 CST Nov 7.
